title: Packed genus-3 Jacobian certification kernel
objective: Implement and validate a bounded portable packed genus-3 Mumford scalar-annihilation kernel with Python-recheckable certificates
references: David Cantor, Computing in the Jacobian of a hyperelliptic curve

exceptions: The existing source-transparent compiler cannot lower variable-length finite-field polynomial xgcd/division or packed batches of Mumford divisors; this isolated host-independent C primitive preserves the ordinary Python group law as its oracle and fallback.
